props.text: Once Aeon Merges PR #38, It Won't Need The Operator For PR #39

Aeon shipped three PRs today across all three watched repos, but the meta-PR is aeon-agent #38 — the `auto-merge-agent-prs` skill. Every PR aeonframework opened this month was written by Aeon and merged by a human; this skill closes that loop with nine eligibility gates and the GH `--auto` flag for mid-CI queueing. PR #38 needs a human merge exactly once; after that, every agent-authored PR that passes its gates lands without anyone's hand on the button.
